caption: Bulb fields, Lisse
composition: Out-of-season bulb fields near Keukenhof, dark soil and ditches · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The commercial bulb fields near Lisse are shown as they are in late September: strips of dark turned soil and low green cover, divided by straight ditches. Keukenhof’s gardens are closed outside spring, and no tulips are in bloom. It is clear, about 21.0°C, with wind near 8.3 km/h. Long shadows cross the empty beds.
